response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, s.shortintrt AS shortintrt, s.optvolrt AS optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref), per_txn AS (SELECT transref, ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_short, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM j GROUP BY transref, ordertypedist), per_mix AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS mix_avg_short FROM j GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT p.transref AS transaction_reference, p.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, p.avg_short AS avg_short_interest, p.avg_opt AS avg_option_volume_ratio, p.avg_short * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.mix_avg_short, 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM per_txn p JOIN per_mix m ON m.ordertypedist IS p.ordertypedist ORDER BY (short_interest_ratio IS NULL), short_interest_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
